verdict.rationale: Clara is a corporate spend management SaaS, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers APIs, MCP, sandbox, cards and webhooks, but nothing documents a telemetry or tracking opt-out control. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
